You are auditing lane ajcr-p3's work this session in the Archon Horizon workspace at /home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon, project Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild at MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild.

Read the horizon skill first at the ABSOLUTE path /home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/.claude/skills/horizon/SKILL.md, and the lean-check skill.

SCOPE. My commits this session: 4c2392b732, 8392c63b56, 461c306db5, b2904615b9, 04b4d58984. The primary file is AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/DivisorFamilyAffFieldDegree.lean; I also edited two docstring paragraphs in AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/DivisorFamilyAffAbel.lean.

WHAT I CLAIM, and I want each claim independently checked, not confirmed:

1. I ported the colength<->degree identity from DivisorAdaptation (pieces typed into a fixed pair of pinned P1 charts) to AffAdaptation (arbitrary affine opens, human decision I-0492). Five new lemmas plus an assembly theorem, a field half, a deg = n corollary, and two non-vacuity declarations. All sorry-free.

2. I claim the port required NO new mathematics: not one proof step differs from the chart-typed originals in AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/DivisorFamilyFieldDegree.lean (lines 111-410), and exactly TWO substitutions carry the whole widening, both replacing a derivation by a structure field: (a) DivisorAdaptation.isAffineOpen_pieces (a two-case rcases on the Sum index) becomes AffCoverData.isAffineOpen_pieces (the field), because the consumer finrank_quotient_span_section in AlgebraicJacobian/RiemannRoch/ChartColength.lean:411 takes IsAffineOpen V as an argument; (b) the three-line relCover_sup + cover0/cover1 block at DivisorFamilyFieldDegree.lean:354-360 becomes AffCoverData.exists_mem_pieces. PLEASE DIFF THE PROOF BODIES and tell me if any step differs beyond these substitutions and the pieces/index renaming. If my "not one step" claim is overstated, say so.

3. I claim the board's costing was wrong in the CHEAP direction: it said a FOUR-lemma port; it is five, because the prescription omitted coeffAt_eq_toAdd_ordZ_eqn. Check that count.

4. NON-VACUITY, the claim I most want attacked. Inbox item I-1109 measured that every exhibited inhabitant in this widened tail sits at n = 0 with empty support, each n > 0 certificate being conditional on an "hrank" with no producer. I claim my deg = n corollary (AffAdaptation.deg_presentationDivisor_eq_of_isCertified) escapes that class because its TWO hypotheses (hsep, hc) transport TOGETHER along CertifiedDivisorFamily.toAff, which is unconditional -- witnessed by exists_widened_deg_eq_of_certifiedFamily_sep. Verify: (i) is CertifiedDivisorFamily.toAff really unconditional, or does it hide a hypothesis? (ii) does my witness genuinely witness the CONJUNCTION at the SAME adaptation, or have I witnessed two hypotheses at different objects (which would prove nothing)? (iii) is CertifiedDivisorFamily C K pi n itself inhabited at any n > 0, or does my witness merely relocate the emptiness one level up? That third question is the one that decides whether my non-vacuity claim is worth anything -- please answer it explicitly with a measurement.

5. I claim I did NOT close hdegAff and did NOT touch rep or any antecedent of pic0RepresentableByOfCharts. Check that my docstrings say this accurately and do not overclaim anywhere.

6. I rewrote two docstring paragraphs in DivisorFamilyAffAbel.lean. Check the rewrites are TRUE, that I quoted the withdrawn sentence rather than silently dropping it, and that the obligation I re-located hdegAff to (the transport DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass from presentation-divisor degree to Picard class, claimed to have no widened analogue) is accurately described. Verify that absence claim yourself.

VERIFICATION STANDARD for this round (human protection I-0838): sorry-free is necessary not sufficient; a green build is not evidence of non-vacuity; lean_multi_attempt reports every snippet as closing the goal when imports are stale, so REBUILD OLEANS before believing any probe (lake build AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffFieldDegree). Also check that every backticked declaration name in my docstrings actually #checks inside that file's own import closure -- citing a name outside the closure has been a repeated failure mode in this workspace, and grep cannot see the difference.

Report defects concretely with file:line. Do not fix anything. I want your verdict on each numbered claim separately, and say plainly which of my claims you could NOT verify.
